extracted.intended_audience: fans seeking free tickets to Last Week Tonight with John Oliver (live studio audience)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and requirements for applying to the Last Week Tonight studio audience ticket lottery, attending tapings, standby policies, and related eligibility/verification rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Residency / presence eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: You must live in the New York City area (NY,NJ,CT) or be in NYC during the filming week to be eligible for tickets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only those living in the tri-state area or physically in NYC that week are eligible. International guests and those outside NY,NJ,CT and PA are handled differently on standby (see standby policy).

rubrics_metrics.name: Age requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be 18 years and older to attend the shows.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No minors admitted; applicants under 18 are ineligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior attendance restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: Do NOT enter the lottery if you have attended the show in ANY SEASON; ONLY fans who have never attended should apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because of high demand, priority is given to people who have not previously seen the show live. Entering despite previous attendance goes against the request and may reduce eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single-entry rule
rubrics_metrics.description: If you enter multiple times in the same lottery you will be eliminated from that lottery. You must apply only once in every lottery you apply to.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply a single time per lottery window. Multiple submissions are grounds for elimination from that specific lottery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Government ID verification
rubrics_metrics.description: All audience members must have a government issued ID to verify their identity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bring acceptable government-issued identification to the taping; verification is required to claim tickets and enter the studio.

rubrics_metrics.name: Arrival time requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: For all shows you must arrive at least 90 minutes in advance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan to be on site significantly earlier than showtime; late arrival could prevent entry. Tapings are generally at 5:00 PM on Saturdays (except where noted).

rubrics_metrics.name: Standby line policy
rubrics_metrics.description: There will be a Standby line this season. Please do not line up or come to the studio prior to 3:10PM on any Saturday we are taping the show.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not arrive before 3:10PM to line up. International guests and those outside of NY, NJ, CT and PA will be given priority on the standby list. Tri-state area fans are encouraged to apply to the lottery instead of relying on standby.

rubrics_metrics.name: International guest instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: International fans: enter the zip code of where you will be staying in the US and enter 10 zeros for the phone number so we know you are an international fan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are an international student studying in the US you do not count as an international fan; only those in the US for shorter stays are considered international. When your lottery entry is confirmed, reply with the best phone number to reach you as staff can text internationally if necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confirmation email response and timeliness
rubrics_metrics.description: If you receive tickets, an email confirmation will provide additional health and safety requirements. If you don't reply to us in a timely manner you might lose your tickets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allowlist the site and check spam/promotions folders to ensure you receive and respond to confirmation emails promptly; failing to reply can result in ticket forfeiture.

rubrics_metrics.name: Health and safety requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: If you receive tickets, an email confirmation will provide additional health and safety requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow any additional health/safety instructions included in your confirmation email; these requirements may be mandatory for entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy and use of personal information
rubrics_metrics.description: This information is NOT shared, sold or used for any purposes other than to accommodate your ticket requests. Our Privacy Policy is available here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Personal information provided for tickets is used only for ticketing; refer to the linked privacy policy for full details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tickets are free and official sources only
rubrics_metrics.description: The tickets are ALWAYS free! The only official sources of information for Last Week Tonight tickets are the official site of Last Week Tonight, this site or our official Facebook or official LWT social media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not give your money to any other website claiming to get you tickets. Beware of third-party sites charging for tickets—these are not legitimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ticket distribution timing / lottery schedule
rubrics_metrics.description: Lottery opens and tickets become available on specific dates/times (e.g., first Season 13 ticket lottery opens Tuesday, January 27th at 3PM; listed show dates have 'Tickets available on' dates).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitor the announced dates and times for lottery openings and ticket availability. All times are in Eastern Daylight Time (EDT).

rubrics_metrics.name: Filming location and schedule notes
rubrics_metrics.description: Filming at The CBS Broadcast Center, 530 West 57th Street; tapings on Saturdays at 5PM except where noted. Specific Saturdays will not be filmed (listed dates).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check the schedule for exceptions and venue details; dates are subject to change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standby priority for non-local guests
rubrics_metrics.description: International guests and those outside of NY, NJ, CT and PA will be given priority on the standby list.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are traveling from outside the immediate region, standby may offer better chances than for local/tri-state residents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not line up early (anti-pattern)
rubrics_metrics.description: Please do not line up or come to the studio prior to 3:10PM on any Saturday we are taping the show.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Arriving much earlier than instructed is discouraged and may violate studio or production policies.
